The education pilot did not go the way the proposal promised. We rolled out the new platform in three courses, and the first two weeks were mostly troubleshooting. Students used it for quizzes, but they skipped the discussion boards. When we asked why, the answers were practical: the boards were hard to find on a phone, and the notifications arrived after the deadline. The platform's analytics were useful, but only after our teaching assistant spent a day cleaning the section names. I would not call the rollout a success yet. It did show us where the friction is, which is more than the vendor's dashboard did.
